records.failed_witness: The first broad activation-baton display omitted bounded intervals before EOF.

records.passing_witness: All 3474 baton lines were read through EOF and the exact Git-blob SHA-256 and 43050-word count matched.
records.recurrence_guard: Measure long packets before display and use numbered windows below the output ceiling.
records.rollback: The truncated read changed no repository or route state.
records.sibling_recommendation: Use bounded numbered packet reads rather than one broad projection.

records.failed_witness: The first full-tools skill-bank display exceeded its bounded output surface.
records.recovery: Reread the complete skill in two exact line windows through EOF.
records.passing_witness: The skill bank and every other named skill and required reference were read completely before mutation.
records.recurrence_guard: Measure large SKILL.md files and split only the display, never the instruction authority.
records.rollback: The display failure occurred before repository mutation.
records.sibling_recommendation: Treat a truncated skill read as incomplete until every line is reread.

records.failed_witness: A combined authorization-state display exceeded the available result budget after line 750.

records.passing_witness: All 1487 authorization-state lines and the complete schema were read and structurally validated.

records.rollback: No global authorization file was changed.
records.sibling_recommendation: Finish large state reads before acting on permissions.

records.failed_witness: The first baton digest probe used git hash-object and therefore returned the Git SHA-1 blob identifier rather than the required SHA-256 commitment.
records.recovery: Read the immutable Git blob bytes and hash them with SHA-256 without newline conversion.
records.recurrence_guard: Name the digest algorithm explicitly and keep Git object identity distinct from content SHA-256.
records.sibling_recommendation: Do not compare SHA-1 Git object identifiers to SHA-256 receipt commitments.

records.failed_witness: The first inline manifest recomputation placed a Python def statement after a semicolon and failed syntax parsing.
records.recovery: Replace the compound inline definition with a bounded lambda and retry only the manifest component.
records.passing_witness: The corrected code parsed and began the exact owner-scoped manifest comparison.
records.recurrence_guard: Do not place Python compound statements after semicolons in command-line programs.
records.rollback: The parser stopped before Git or filesystem state changed.
records.sibling_recommendation: Use a lambda or newline-delimited helper for bounded python -c probes.

records.failed_witness: The corrected full manifest recomputation exceeded the thirty-second wrapper and its session handle was not retained for attributable output.
records.recovery: Wait for the exact process to exit, then compare source-to-evidence and source-to-final path sets and scoped tree blob-mode pairs without rehashing every blob.
records.passing_witness: The 79-entry evidence and 99-entry final manifests matched their exact Git path sets and every scoped blob and mode.
records.recurrence_guard: Project one bounded manifest property set and always retain any running session handle.
records.rollback: The completed read-only process wrote no receipt and the canonical aggregate was not replayed.
records.sibling_recommendation: Prefer batch tree identity checks to slow per-blob console recomputation.

records.failed_witness: An unquoted PowerShell commit-peel expression changed the native git cat-file argument shape and produced an unknown-switch error.
records.recovery: Pass the complete revision expression as one quoted literal argument.
records.passing_witness: The quoted commit-peel existence probe returned exit zero for the exact Caelen final.
records.recurrence_guard: Quote Git revision expressions containing braces in PowerShell.
records.rollback: The failing and passing probes were read-only.
records.sibling_recommendation: Keep revision peeling inside one quoted native argument.

records.failed_witness: A grouped post-sparse probe did not retain an attributable status exit code.

records.passing_witness: The isolated checks proved exact head and branch, six patterns, four initial files and a clean worktree.
records.recurrence_guard: Do not hide individual process handles inside a long grouped orchestration wrapper.
records.rollback: No extra checkout or file write occurred.
records.sibling_recommendation: Split state probes when each exit code is part of the evidence.

records.failed_witness: A git ls-files --sparse diagnostic projected unrelated sparse-index entries outside the intended owner display scope.
records.recovery: Use git sparse-checkout list plus materialized rg --files and exact owner-delta Git paths instead.
records.passing_witness: The bounded recovery showed only the six rules and four materialized shared files.
records.recurrence_guard: Never use sparse-index enumeration as a materialized-owner inventory.
records.rollback: The over-broad projection was read-only and no sibling path was opened or mutated.
records.sibling_recommendation: Distinguish sparse index contents from materialized owner scope.

records.failed_witness: The first corpus keyword projection had a missing closing parenthesis in a list comprehension and failed syntax parsing.

records.failed_witness: The corrected corpus keyword projection used the Windows legacy stdout codec and failed on a Māori character.
records.recovery: Set process-local PYTHONIOENCODING to UTF-8 and rerun only the read-only projection.
records.passing_witness: The UTF-8 recovery preserved all 3690 rows and disclosed inherited seed, herbarium, floristry, chess and other collision domains.
records.recurrence_guard: Pin UTF-8 before any Windows process can emit Māori text.
records.sibling_recommendation: Make Unicode output encoding explicit before corpus audits.

records.failed_witness: The first candidate-title audit embedded JSON in a raw triple-quoted command string and failed with an unterminated literal.

records.recurrence_guard: Use structured process-local transport instead of nested quote grammars.
records.rollback: The parser failure changed no file.
records.sibling_recommendation: Avoid nested raw-string quoting for Unicode JSON command payloads.

boundary: Every startup failure remains false and zero-credit. The paired recovery is bounded same-owner workflow evidence only.
